第(1/3)页

[主角同款系统签到处！]

[脑子存在这里！]

鹏城的周末傍晚，天渐渐暗了下来，伴随着一阵打雷声。

出租屋里，范理正吃着外卖，刷着短视频，突然手机上弹出一个电话。

是自己上级林经理。

“林经理？有什么事吗？”

经理林东叹了口气，“范理，有个事和你说一下……嗯……就是……”

范理听到电话里面支支吾吾的，打断道，“领导，怎么了今天，有话直说啊。”

林东在电话那边酝酿了一会说道，“新来的总监决定要开除你。哎！我劝说好久都拦不住。”

范理听到这个消息愣了一会。

他在这家传媒公司干了三年，其中负责的几个主播业绩都不错。

上周新入职了一个总监，范理虽然感觉这个新来的总监不太好说话，但是开除自己也不至于吧。

范理问道，“为什么啊？”

林东叹了口气说道，“总监看了我们的考勤，说你一个月起码迟到10次。然后又去问了你负责的几个主播，那几个主播都说他们自己的能力，和你没关系。所以……”

范理差点鼻子都气歪了，没好气道，“林经理，你是知道的，咱们这几年业绩不行，我天天盯着数据，要复盘，开会，定计划，主播也是我带，搞得我压力大，失眠。我迟到我承认，但是我晚上都有加班吧？好！这些我都不说了。那三个主播哪个不是我一把带出来的。”

电话那边沉默了，范理在公司的付出同事们都看得到，除了那几个白眼狼。

之前还有同事劝范理。

“这几个人不太适合，如果非要带出来可能要花很大的精力。”

当时范理看这几人一脸真诚的模样，还是决定带着这三人。

电话那边的林东开口道，“我和总监沟通了很久，但是那三个人的说法都一致，总监压根不信任我。”

范理压着怒火，平静道，“林经理，我知道你现在也不好干。那我在公司干了三年，现在开除我，是不是应该有赔偿！”

林东说道，“赔偿有，我和人事沟通了，能给到N加1，明天周一发工资就一并给你打过去。”

范理点点头道，“那谢谢林经理了，改天请你吃饭。”

说完，电话挂断，范理感觉外卖都不香了。

畜生啊！踏马的畜生啊！

平时这三个主播在公司装的人模狗样的，背后捅起刀子来毫不留情，范理是真的有点生气了。

[The brain exists here!]

On the weekend evening in Pengcheng, the sky gradually darkened, accompanied by a burst of thunder.

In the rental house, Fan Li was eating takeout and watching short videos when a call suddenly popped up on his phone.

It's his superior, Manager Lin.

"Manager Lin? What's the matter?"

Manager Lin Dong sighed, "Fan Li, I have something to tell you... um... just..."

Fan Li heard the hesitation on the phone and interrupted, "Boss, what's wrong today? If you have anything to say, just say it."

Lin Dong pondered over the phone for a while and said, "The new director has decided to fire you. Alas! I have been trying to persuade you for a long time, but I can't stop you."

Fan Li was stunned for a while when he heard the news.

He has worked at this media company for three years, and the several anchors he is responsible for have performed well.

A new director was hired last week. Although Fan Li felt that the new director was not easy to talk to, it would not be wrong to fire him.

Fan Li asked, "Why?"

Lin Dong sighed and said, "The director looked at our attendance records and said that you were late at least 10 times a month. Then he asked the anchors you were responsible for, and those anchors said that their own abilities had nothing to do with you. So..."

Fan Li almost got angry and said, "Manager Lin, you know that our performance has not been good in the past few years. I stare at the data every day, review, hold meetings, and make plans. I am also the anchor, which makes me stressed and sleepless. I admit that I am late, but I work overtime at night, right? Okay! I won't talk about these. I didn't lead any of the three anchors."

There was silence on the other side of the phone. Fan Li's efforts in the company could be seen by all his colleagues, except for those few white-eyed wolves.

Some colleagues had tried to persuade Fan Li before.

"These few people are not suitable. If we have to bring them out, it may take a lot of effort."

At that time, Fan Li saw the sincere looks on these people's faces, so he decided to take these three people with him.

Lin Dong on the other side of the phone said, "I communicated with the director for a long time, but the three people all said the same thing. The director doesn't trust me at all."

Fan Li suppressed his anger and said calmly, "Manager Lin, I know it's not easy for you to work now. So I've been working in the company for three years, and now I'm fired, should I be compensated?"

Lin Dong said, "There is compensation. I have communicated with the human resources department and if I can give it N plus 1, I will send you the salary together with your salary tomorrow Monday."

Fan Li nodded and said, "Thank you, Manager Lin. I'll treat you to dinner another day."

After saying that, Fan Li hung up the phone and felt that the takeout no longer tasted good.

What a beast!You beast that rides on a horse!

Normally these three anchors act like dogs in the company and stab them in the back without mercy. Fan Li was really a little angry.
